about: I am a model and prop maker with a keen affinity for sculpting, based in the UK. My interests in stop-motion animation, history, Tolkienesque fantasy and English folklore inform my work. My experience includes stop-motion creature fabrication, architectural models, moulding, casting and prop making.

entries.title: Timothy Richards & Modern Souvenir
entries.text: Sculptor, crafts person and model maker. Sculpting, mould making, finishing and batch production of plaster souvenirs and architectural models, including new product development and origination of architectural models.

entries.title: Mangostone
entries.text: Model maker and sculptor. Mould making, casting, fabrication and painting of props and models for the BBC's Famous Five production.

entries.title: Yamination Studios
entries.text: Sculptor and model maker. Model, set and puppet making, character maquette sculpting, and work with directors on stop-motion television and commercials.

entries.title: Workshed Animation
entries.text: Stop-motion puppet fabricator. Multiple commissions for a film studio in the USA, interpreting the client brief to design, build and finish detailed puppets.

entries.title: Prop Making & SFX: client projects
entries.text: Helped lead a collaborative team project for Peter Thorndike's debut film, PlaguePits.
